normalization_probe.input: Thirty minutes of generated mono silence, 16 kHz FLAC
normalization_probe.measurement: Separate decoder test processes under /usr/bin/time -l; not aggregate application/CoreML memory

limitations: Fine-grained inference progress/cancellation, priority scheduling and within-source chunk resume remain unfinished.
Live preview, retention controls and microphone/Bluetooth/dual-source hardware acceptance remain separate work.
The 30-minute normalization probe is synthetic, sequential, and measures one preparation stage; Core ML and OS file-cache memory are not established by it.
Diarization equivalence on one 11-second public clip is a regression check, not broader accuracy or long-meeting quality proof.
Only system capture was exercised; microphone permission remains not determined and M3 is untested.
